faq.q: What is the TikTok Ads integration in Cekat.AI?
faq.a: The connection from TikTok ads to conversations via two routes: TikTok Inbox Ads opening TikTok DMs, and Click-to-WhatsApp opening WhatsApp Business chats. Both land in one inbox with campaign attribution.

faq.q: When should we use the TikTok DM route?
faq.a: For light lead generation, product consultation, and bookings, when you want to answer people without moving them out of the app they already have open.

faq.q: When is the WhatsApp route the better fit?
faq.a: For sales needing intensive follow-up. WhatsApp brings the conversation onto your business number with the CRM, automated follow-ups, and one unified history.

faq.q: Can both routes run at the same time?
faq.a: Yes. The route is chosen per campaign, and all the chats still land in the same inbox, so the team never switches tools.
Chats arriving from ads carry their origin campaign into the CRM, so you read leads and closings per TikTok campaign without manual recaps.

faq.q: Are conversions sent back to TikTok?
faq.a: Yes, through the TikTok Pixel and Events API. Sales that happen in chat become optimization signals, so the next ads find people who resemble your buyers.

faq.q: Does the AI answer TikTok leads too?
faq.a: Yes. Chats from both routes are treated the same: answered in the first second, qualified, and handed to the team when ready to close.

faq.q: Do competitors have TikTok integration too?
faq.a: Mostly not yet. On our comparison page, TikTok DM and TikTok Ads sit among the rows other platforms most rarely tick.
